details.jobDescription:
ALTEN Romania is part of the ALTEN Group, Leader in IT and Engineering Consulting. We develop innovative and durable technical solutions that fulfill the needs of our local and international partners.︁︀​︂︀︀​︁︂︉​︇︉


To ensure success, you need the following skills
  • Proven experience in technical project management, engineering coordination, or work package management.
  • At least 5 years of technical experience in software development, software engineering, quality engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in a technical leadership or management role.
  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycle and systems engineering principles.
  • Experience coordinating multidisciplinary engineering teams across complex projects.
  • Ability to manage technical scope, planning, workload, dependencies, and delivery commitments.
  • Strong risk management skills with the ability to proactively identify and mitigate project risks.
  • Experience working with bids, proposals, and project estimations.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including customer-facing interactions.
  • Strong facilitation skills for workshops, scope definition sessions, and technical discussions.
  • Experience coordinating verification, validation, integration, and qualification activities.
  • Knowledge of configuration and change management processes and tools such as Jira.
  • Ability to work effectively in complex, matrix, and international environments.
  • Strong analytical thinking, decision-making, and problem-solving skills.
  • Commitment to delivery excellence, continuous improvement, and customer satisfaction.
About this role
As a Technical Project Manager, you will take ownership of software engineering work packages, ensuring the successful delivery of complex solutions within agreed timelines, budget, and quality standards. Acting as the Software Work Package Manager (SW WPM), you will coordinate multidisciplinary engineering teams, manage technical risks and dependencies, and serve as a key interface between project, engineering, verification, and customer stakeholders. You will play a pivotal role in driving execution, governance, and delivery excellence throughout the project lifecycle.


A typical day might include the following activities
  • Plan, assign, and coordinate engineering activities to achieve project milestones and delivery objectives.
  • Collaborate closely with Project Design Authorities (PDA), Integration Verification Validation and Qualification Managers (IVVQM), Project Managers, and Engineering teams.
  • Review and challenge proposed technical designs to ensure alignment with project constraints, objectives, and customer expectations.
  • Coordinate engineering activities across multiple teams and sub-systems to ensure solution compatibility and integration.
  • Monitor project progress, workload, schedules, and technical deliverables, ensuring commitments are met.
  • Identify, assess, monitor, and mitigate technical risks while managing associated action plans.
  • Define and formalize work package scope, requirements, deliverables, and resource needs.
  • Ensure requirements integrity, traceability, and consistency throughout project execution.
  • Manage technical interactions with subcontractors and support procurement and supplier assessment activities.
  • Collaborate with customers on technical aspects of project execution and solution delivery.
  • Support verification, validation, qualification, and integration activities to ensure successful deployment.
  • Coordinate dependencies between internal and external stakeholders and ensure effective follow-up.
  • Contribute to bid and proposal activities, providing technical and delivery expertise.
  • Produce project status reports and communicate progress, risks, issues, and resource requirements to stakeholders.
  • Drive continuous improvement by promoting project management best practices, processes, and delivery methodologies.
  • Balance project priorities while maintaining the appropriate focus on quality, cost, and schedule objectives.

ALTEN Romania, part of the international ALTEN Group - with a unique position as Leader in IT & Engineering Consulting, provides support for its clients’ development strategies in the fields of innovation, R&D and IT systems since 1996. The company comprises 2 divisions specialized on its core capabilities: ENGINEERING and IT.

ALTEN Romania has a team of over 500 consultants that work on ambitious projects from offices in Bucharest, Timisoara, Sibiu, Cluj-Napoca, Pitesti, Craiova.

ALTEN IT division offers software development services, business and technical analysis, support, maintenance and monitoring for national & international clients. 310 consultants from 3 cities (Bucharest, Pitesti, Craiova) are working on ambitious projects for leading global companies in banking, telecommunications and services sectors.

The IT Division has a team of consultants who are specifically specialized in Java, .NET, PHP, C#, C++, Siebel, Cognos, MS BI and Oracle BI, BSCS, PMP.

ALTEN Engineering division provides services in different sectors such as automotive, aeronautics, railways and energy with a team of 160 engineers from 4 cities (Bucharest, Timisoara, Sibiu, Cluj Napoca). Our consultants deliver innovative solutions for our customers, being specifically specialized in CATIA V5, NewPDM, SolidWorks, Matlab/ Simulink, HIL, Embedded Systems.
